results.title: Can You Use the Nike Logo Legally? Trademark Guide
excerpts: Not without risk - trademark law helps safeguard against consumer confusion and protects brand identity. Under the Lanham Act, which governs U.S. trademark law, unauthorised commercial use of the Swoosh invites an infringement claim.

results.title: Nike trademark enforcement record
excerpts: Nike alleged trademark infringement, claiming that the design copied the iconic Swoosh logo and other elements associated with Nike's Dunk sneakers, and moved swiftly for injunctive relief.
